title: Endpoint
description: One API endpoint: how to call it and what it answers. Strings may contain {{variables}}.

id.description: Unique id, 'area.action' (e.g. site.create). The file is endpoints/<area>/<id>.json.

title.description: One line: what the call does.

api.description: A key of catalog.json 'apis' (base URL and auth headers).

host.description: Fills {{host}} in the API's base URL (Command subdomain, e.g. vprovision).

path.description: Path under the base URL; may contain {{variables}}.

effect.description: What calling it does. Only 'read' endpoints are called automatically.

auth.description: 'none' for calls made before login / with their own credentials.

autocheck.description: false: don't call this read endpoint automatically.

warning.description: Shown before the endpoint is called by hand.

params.description: Variables the request needs besides the session's (org_id, user_id, email, …) and catalog defaults.

body.description: JSON body template. A string that is exactly '{{name}}' keeps the variable's type.

status.description: Statuses that are a normal answer, e.g. ["2xx", 404].

schema.description: JSON Schema of the response body (inferred from observed responses).

example.description: Sanitised example response (ids/names replaced by <field> placeholders).

source.description: Where the endpoint was learned from (HAR, typed in, vCommander, …).
